The final search returned **17,383 records** through the 2018-11-17 publication cutoff. Its depression block returned 460,494; the relapse/recurrence block returned 706,784; their intersection returned 17,415 before the date limit. Relative recall was 100% against the five records found and screened during this build. That small development set is not independent validation and does not estimate sensitivity.

The psychological-theory criterion is handled at screening, so the query is broad. The draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
